title: Accepted open questions (private/evidence/<model>_fw<firmware>/accepted_<model>_fw<firmware>.json)
description: What pass 2's report holds that kit/schema_update.py --write does not settle, each looked at by a person and accepted with why: the mapper's own file, private whole, for each entry is a ruling on one mapping's report (docs/decisions/0016); the pull request carries the gate's count. --write refuses while the report holds a conflict the writer leaves standing, a new record it does not add, a record not one to one, a name dispute or a carried-over value that no entry here covers; --force writes anyway, never for a submission.

$schema.description: This file's JSON Schema, relative to the file.

model.description: The model, as the definition names it, for example ILCE-1M2.

firmware.description: The firmware of the definition's layout, for example 4.00.

about.description: What the file is, in a sentence.

accepted.description: One entry per accepted question. An entry covers the report's questions of its kind and key, and of its value and label where it names them: without a value it covers every value of the record.

kind.description: conflict: the writer kept a label against the camera's reading (a hand rule, or a reading not sure); new: a record the report proved that the writer does not add; not one to one: a label wrote two values, or two labels one value (the record is marked disputed); name dispute: the bar's OCR or the vision model read another name than the map's; carried over: a record kept the option before's value while others moved.

key.description: The record, as the definition keys it.

value.description: The stored value the question is about, when it is about one; never for a carried-over value, which may be the camera's own setting (decision 16).

label.description: The definition's label of the value (conflict, name dispute) or the option chosen (carried over).

camera.description: What the camera's screen read, for the record (not matched).

why.description: Why it stands: the proof, the hand rule or the reason, in a sentence or two.
